item.title: In the Grip of God - Kevin Kiefer
item.dc:creator: thrive
item.content:encoded: In the book of Genesis, we meet Jacob. Jacob was Isaac's son, and as we hear his story, we discover that Jacob was a person who struggled to trust God. When Jacob had a need, he worked hard to get what he wanted, even if that meant manipulating or hurting others so that he could get ahead. In this sermon, Kevin shows us how sometimes when we ask God for help, God chooses instead to give us something far greater than what we asked for. But HOW God works blessing into our lives may surprise us!

item.title: How to Build a Boat - Molly Kiefer
item.dc:creator: aidenkiefer
item.content:encoded: Pastor Molly Kiefer uses the universally relatable experience of being unprepared for a big event to illustrate divine preparation in our spiritual lives. Through the story of Noah in Genesis 6, she shows how Noah’s faithfulness and close walk with God equipped him for his monumental task. Pastor Molly emphasizes the importance of being attuned to God’s voice, sharing a personal story of prayer and gratitude that led to an unexpected discovery. Reflecting on Noah’s immediate and humble obedience, she encourages us to reignite our commitment to God’s kingdom, focusing on His plans for redemption and restoration. This message is a stirring call to embrace urgent obedience and a humble walk with God.

item.title: Restored by His Reign - Kevin Kiefer
item.dc:creator: aidenkiefer
item.content:encoded: This week, Pastor Kevin grapples with the concept of living in the "now and not yet" of the Kingdom of God. How do we live as conduits of God's Kingdom while making peace with the reality that God doesn't always act the way that we expect Him to? The sermon concludes with a challenge to cultivate faith and live as active agents in bringing about God's will. Join us this Sunday as we are challenged to cultivate faith and embrace the tension of the now and not yet, trusting in God's ultimate plan while actively fighting for healing and transformation in the present.

item.title: Be Filled: A Pentecost Sermon - Kevin Kiefer
item.dc:creator: aidenkiefer
item.content:encoded:
Have you ever felt a longing for a deeper connection with God?
This Pentecost Sunday, join us as we explore the transformative power of the Holy Spirit.
Pastor Kevin dives into the thrilling account of Pentecost from Acts 2, revealing a pivotal shift. Discover the impact of how God's presence moved from a physical location inside the temple to reside within believers themselves, ready to empower and transform us.
Imagine living a life overflowing with God's love, radiating joy, and impacting the world around you. This sermon unpacks the key to unlocking this reality – the infilling of the Holy Spirit.

item.title: The Power of Spiritual Gifts in Building Community - Wendy Seidman
item.dc:creator: aidenkiefer
item.content:encoded:
Feeling like a puzzle piece searching for its place within the bigger picture? This week, we delve into the beautiful tapestry of spiritual gifts!
Remember the story of the early Church, a fledgling community brimming with potential but lacking direction? Today, we unlock the secret weapon gifted by the Holy Spirit – the unique talents He bestows on each believer.
Join us as we explore 1 Corinthians 12, where the Apostle Paul unveils this extraordinary truth. Discover the spectrum of gifts, from the fiery passion of encouragement to the steady hand of service.
Imagine using your God-given skills to not only enrich your own faith, but to build up the entire body of Christ! This sermon equips you to identify your gift and unleash its potential, fostering a thriving and impactful faith community.
Don't miss this chance to discover the unique role you were created to play!

item.title: Living the Parable of the Good Samaritan - Kevin Kiefer
item.dc:creator: aidenkiefer
item.content:encoded:
Have you ever been unexpectedly touched by an act of kindness?
In this week's episode of Thrive Vineyard Church Sermon of the Week, we embark on a journey through the parable of the Good Samaritan. Pastor Kevin draws insightful parallels between this timeless story and our modern lives, urging us to recognize and respond to the brokenness around us. Be prepared to rethink your own capacity for compassion and sacrifice as we examine the importance of loving our neighbors, regardless of the personal cost involved.
Join us on this transformative journey to not only learn about, but to also start living out the sacrificial, compassionate love that truly marks us as followers of Christ.

item.title: Mediterranean Messages: Galatians - Molly Kiefer
item.dc:creator: aidenkiefer
item.content:encoded: Is self-help getting you the life you want? Feeling stuck and wondering if your best effort can really produce the results you hope for? Our culture idolizes self-improvement and hustle. But Paul’s message cuts through this noise: only by surrendering to Christ, allowing Him to live through us, can we experience true freedom and transformation. This sermon invites you to reframe your life’s narrative, making Jesus the central character. Are you ready to shift your perspective, relinquish control, and live a life of unshakeable faith? Dive into Galatians and discover the liberating power of the Gospel.

Same Life. Transformed Mind. Real Change.

Key Takeaways

  • The renewing of your mind is the biblical path to personal transformation (Romans 12:2).

  • Science now confirms what Scripture has always taught—our thoughts physically shape our brains.

  • Taking every thought captive (2 Corinthians 10:4–5) is an act of spiritual warfare and mental freedom.

  • Change starts not with willpower, but with thought power and choosing what we dwell on.

Reflective Exercise: Grow New Thought Pathways

Use the “Groan to Gratitude” tool:

  1. Write down a daily frustration.

  2. Follow it with a gratitude statement that honors God’s nature.

  3. Repeat as a daily practice to retrain your thinking toward peace, hope, and joy.

Example:
Groan: Overwhelmed
Gratitude: Thank you, God, that I don’t have to carry this alone—you’ve always been faithful.

Transformation That Lasts

Just like a tree grows one branch at a time, your thought life creates lasting paths in your brain. Every time you choose gratitude over anxiety, truth over lies, faith over fear—you build the life God promised: one of peace, abundance, and renewal.

In this message, we’ll discover that true renovation begins not with changing our situation, but with opened eyes to the greatness of Christ already at work within us.

This message explores the difference between aspirational faith and actual identity, and how grace reshapes not just our theology but our reflexes. We’ll look at where we may still be trying to earn what was meant to be received—and how to live confidently from the seat Jesus has already secured for us. Come ready to breathe deeper and rediscover what it means to live from grace.

When ordinary, very different people are united in Christ, the wisdom of God becomes visible in ways that echo into the unseen world. This Sunday we’ll explore why the church might be God’s most surprising masterpiece.

In Epistle to the Ephesians 3:14–19, we’re invited into something most of us have heard about… but never fully experienced.

If you’re longing for renewed faith, clarity, and a deeper encounter with God, this is a message you won’t want to miss.

This message will challenge you to not just remove what’s broken, but to replace it with something better.

Whether you are a mom, daughter, father, student, or simply someone longing to grow in faith, this message will encourage you to trust God boldly and live with greater confidence in His purpose for your life.

item.title: A Playbook for Unity - Molly Kiefer

Together, we’ll explore a practical framework for understanding difficult Scriptures and discover how Jesus reshapes the way we think about love, relationships, leadership, and what it means to truly live Spirit-filled lives. Whether you’re married, single, skeptical, or simply curious, this message is for anyone who wants to learn how to read Scripture through the life-giving lens of Jesus.
